changes: Each game gets its own /KUI/vmu-test/pNNNN card, bound by game.bin to its IP product number, selected or created by the launcher, whose P2 profile fills the virtual-A2 module slot before handoff.

A new card is a verified blank image, zero journal, fresh identity and game.bin written last, made only after every existing pair's clusters still read as allocated; its profile comes from the import tool's raw ownership scan once and is reused while CID, partition, geometry and file clusters match.
Card admission no longer refuses names, duplicate names, entry bytes 0x1c-0x1f or the root colour and icon; the packer copies them as written.
PC tool kui-game-cards.py copies shared-card saves onto game cards; the shared pair is only read.
The package ships the PC game-card and library tools.
